description: This file defines a Joystick class for handling on-screen joystick input in Unity, including virtual axis management, drag handling, and pointer events.

classes.name: Joystick
classes.description: Handles on-screen joystick input, supports drag, pointer down/up events, and virtual axis creation for cross-platform input.

methods.name: OnEnable
methods.description: Creates virtual axes when the object is enabled.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initializes the start position of the joystick.

methods.name: UpdateVirtualAxes
methods.description: Updates the virtual axes based on joystick position relative to start position.

methods.name: CreateVirtualAxes
methods.description: Creates and registers virtual axes depending on configuration.

methods.name: OnDrag
methods.description: Handles dragging events, updates joystick position and virtual axes.

methods.name: OnPointerUp
methods.description: Resets joystick to start position when pointer is released.

methods.name: OnPointerDown
methods.description: Empty handler for pointer down events.

methods.name: OnDisable
methods.description: Removes virtual axes when joystick is disabled.
